information

For sale, a 2 room apartment on Vardanants street, in the Center district, near Sakharov Square. It is 100 meters from Republic Square and the metro, in a historic and cultural building.
The apartment is 54 m², on the 5th floor of a 5-storey stone building. It is tastefully renovated and suitable for 1-3 people. The apartment is very bright and has 2 small balconies.
It comes with everything needed for living, including an air conditioner, refrigerator, internet, smart TV, gas stove, microwave oven, oven, a tank, and an Italian pump. It is heated by both the air conditioner and underfloor heating.
